items.legacy_note: Sell it once you're out of slots.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-8,800 (levels 1-15). 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Compress Cooldown. Ultimate (Hotel Guest) is available from Rapid Recharge.

items.name: High-Velocity Rounds
items.why: weapon investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Heroic Aura, 16800 souls (~16.8 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Opening Rounds
items.why: weapon investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Heroic Aura, 16000 souls (~16.0 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Extra Charge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Call Bell (2 to 3).

items.name: Healing Rite
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Rescue Beam, 9600 souls (~9.6 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Grit
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Rescue Beam, 8800 souls (~8.8 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Rapid Recharge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Call Bell (3 to 4). Upgrade of Extra Charge (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power. Imbued on Luggage Cart: takes 18% off its 30s base cooldown.

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Rescue Beam, 4000 souls (~4.0 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 8,800-20,800 (levels 15-26). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Doorway T3, Luggage Cart T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Call Bell, explosion damage) grows from 185 to 237. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Rescue Beam, weapon 4.8k at Heroic Aura.

items.name: Guardian Ward
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Rescue Beam, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)
items.legacy_note: Put it on the mate you're about to cart in.

items.name: Trophy Collector
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Rescue Beam completes 2,400 souls on. Upgrade of Sprint Boots (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: imminent: Rescue Beam completes 4.8k vitality in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Rescue Beam
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (4,000 to 6,400 invested, crossing the 4.8k, 6.4k tiers): bonus 20 to 42 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Healing Rite (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Enchanter's Emblem
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 6,400 to 8,000 invested: bonus 42 to 46 vitality bonus.

items.name: Heroic Aura
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (1,600 to 4,800 invested): bonus 12 to 46% weapon damage.
items.legacy_note: Only if your team has gun heroes.

items.name: Slowing Hex
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power.

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: +10 spirit adds about 15 to Hotel Guest's late checkout damage (1.50x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling.

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: +18 spirit adds about 27 to Hotel Guest's late checkout damage (1.50x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 7,200 to 8,000 invested: bonus 45 to 52 spirit power. Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

items.name: Warp Stone
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 8,000 to 11,200 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus. | Temporary, sold when you buy Cheat Death later.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 198s; 20% off is 39.6s per full rotation.

items.name: Vortex Web
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 9,600 to 14,400 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 30,400-49,600 (levels 30-36). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Call Bell T3, Hotel Guest T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Call Bell, explosion damage) grows from 251 to 385.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun. Takes vitality from 11,200 to 16,000 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Upgrade of Guardian Ward. If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Knockdown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 14,400 to 17,600 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power.
items.legacy_note: Knockdown their carry, then cart a mate in on them as the stun lands.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 45 to Hotel Guest's late checkout damage (1.50x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 17,600 to 22,400 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power. Upgrade of Improved Spirit (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

items.name: Cheat Death
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Guardian Ward? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Knockdown.
sections.desc: Dying after Guardian Ward? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Knockdown.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Their spirit damage keeps hurting you after the hit, like Infernus burn or Seven's ult.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ult or stun you can see coming.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Hexes and slows that let them catch you.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented

items.name: Alchemical Fire
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Instead of Heroic Aura when your team has no gun heroes.

items.name: Cursed Relic
items.caption: Silences, disarms and blocks item use on one enemy for 3.25s and strips their non-ultimate buffs, at -25% damage for you and a 55s cooldown: a single-target answer to a buffed carry or engage. Replaces Warp Stone: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Witchmail
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 19,200 to 24,000 invested: bonus 54 to 60 vitality bonus.

items.name: Refresher
items.caption: Resets every ability and charge: up to 198s of base cooldown across your kit, 120s of it the ultimate; the item has its own cooldown of 300s. Takes spirit from 22,400 to 28,800 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power. Replaces Enchanter's Emblem: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..
